# hg team

**What this page tells you:** every `hg team` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Plan, publish and track a complete registered agent-team installation.

## Synopsis

```text
hg team inspect <skill-directory>
hg team compile [flags]
hg team plan [flags]
hg team apply [flags]
hg team resume [flags]
hg team status [flags]
hg team publish [flags]
hg team overlays prepare [flags]
hg team overlays approve [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

Reads a versioned bootstrap-owned installation plan. Generated GitOps changes are published only through the team publisher. Required unknown or failed stages leave installation incomplete. A version 2 plan publishes only the source commits recorded in its installation lock, which `hg team compile` writes. Operator overlays publish only after `hg team overlays approve` records a human decision over exactly their content.

## `hg team inspect`

```text
hg team inspect <skill-directory>
```

Inspect a skill directory's reproducible content hash.

## `hg team compile`

```text
hg team compile [flags]
```

Resolve a version 2 plan's tag or commit refs into its installation lock.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--plan` | `<file>` | — | Bootstrap-owned installation YAML: version 1, or version 2 with tag or commit refs and a committed lock; required. |
| `--dir` | `<bootstrap-root>` | — | Bootstrap checkout containing the plan and environment; defaults to cwd. |

**Examples**

```bash
hg team compile --plan teams/installation.yaml --dir ./bootstrap --json
```

## `hg team resume`

```text
hg team resume [flags]
```

Resume installation after rechecking source revisions and live evidence.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--unattended` | — | — | Watcher mode (needs a version 2 plan): exit 0 complete, 75 pending on a human decision, merge or convergence, 1 failed; prints one JSON report. Never approves, merges a non-auto-merge PR, flips an activation gate or runs an un-opted write scenario. |
| `--plan` | `<file>` | — | Bootstrap-owned installation YAML: version 1, or version 2 with tag or commit refs and a committed lock; required. |
| `--dir` | `<bootstrap-root>` | — | Bootstrap checkout containing the plan and environment; defaults to cwd. |

**Examples**

```bash
hg team resume --plan teams/installation.yaml --dir ./bootstrap --json
```

## `hg team overlays prepare`

```text
hg team overlays prepare [flags]
```

Fetch, hash and merge each agent's operator overlays and stage them for human review.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--plan` | `<file>` | — | Bootstrap-owned installation YAML whose sources or agents declare overlays; required. |
| `--dir` | `<bootstrap-root>` | — | Bootstrap checkout containing the plan; defaults to cwd. |
| `--stage` | `<dir>` | — | A new review directory outside every source repository; defaults under $HG_HOME/overlay-reviews. |

**Examples**

```bash
hg team overlays prepare --plan teams/installation.yaml --dir ./bootstrap --json
```

## `hg team overlays approve`

```text
hg team overlays approve [flags]
```

Record a named human's approval of one staged operator overlay review.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--review` | `<review.json>` | — | The staged review a human inspected. |
| `--approval-file` | `<file>` | — | The source's bootstrap-owned skillPolicy.approvals file. |
| `--approver` | `<name>` | — | The human recording the decision. |
| `--fingerprint` | `<sha256>` | — | The fingerprint the human reviewed; must equal the review's. |

**Examples**

```bash
hg team overlays approve --review <stage>/<agent>/review.json --approval-file teams/approvals.yaml --approver 'A. Operator' --fingerprint <sha256>
```
